title: eng-hiring-onboarding-interview-debriefs-weekly-sync-2026-04-21
content:
Weekly interview debriefs + onboarding sync (standup-style) - notes and action items.

Attendees: Aisha (notes), Jordan, Priya, Carlos, Emilia (joining for onboarding pairing update).

Purpose: quick consolidations of interview outcomes this week, open roles prioritization, onboarding blockers for new hires, and team health signals. Mostly raw notes - will synthesize for hiring docs and recruiting followups.

Candidates interviewed this week:
- CAND-117 (Backend SWE, infra/serving-runtime): Strong systems design, good run-time scaling intuition. Pros: thoughtful tradeoffs on KV cache, latency-sensitive scheduling; clear production debugging examples. Cons: weaker ML infra context (quantization/FP16 tradeoffs) - could ramp with mentorship. Interviewers: Jordan, Priya. Recommendation: move to onsites (pass). Recruiter: Maria to schedule.
- CAND-120 (SRE / Reliability): Good incident handling examples, ran multiple paged incidents at scale. Observability mindset strong. Concern: limited exposure to GPU infra specifics (NVIDIA toolchain) - but team noted this is trainable. Interviewers: Carlos, Emilia. Recommendation: interview loop pass, consider heavier on-call ramp.
- CAND-123 (Applied ML infra): Excellent LLM serving work, strong benchmarking and quantization experience. Cultural fit seemed excellent. Interviewers noted can own model compilation improvements quickly. Recommendation: strong yes.
- CAND-118 (Frontend / Console): Solid product sense, but weaker on large-scale telemetry UI patterns we need. Suggest take-home focused on metric visualizations if proceeding.

Hiring pipeline updates / priorities:
- Prioritize hires for serving-runtime (Backend SWE) and SRE - capacity pressure expected with 2 upcoming major customer pilots in May.
- Applied ML infra candidate (CAND-123) is high priority - hiring manager (Priya) will push for offer this week.
- Console FE role: deprioritize until after next sprint unless we see an obvious strong fit.
- Interview capacity: need 2 more interviewers for backend loop; Jordan to confirm availability from infra eng (ask: Mateo, Liwei).

Interview process notes / calibration:
- Use updated rubric v2 (linked in Confluence). Interviewers generally calibrated for system design and debugging sections, but variability observed in ML-specific knowledge scoring. Action: 1-hr calibration session (Priya to run) next Tue 2026-04-28.
- Time-to-offer: pipeline slow at offer stage - average days in-loop = 18. Recruiter feedback: need faster debriefs (same-day) and clearer hiring criteria for borderline candidates. We should aim to cut to <=10 days for high-priority roles. Action: set expectation with hiring managers and recruiters.

Onboarding / new hire updates:
- New hires started last week: 2 SREs (Ravi K., Mei H.) and 1 Backend SWE (Janelle T.). Early signals: positive, ramping through runbook pairing and internal runbook exercises.
- Onboarding checklist gaps noted:
  - Access to internal GPU test clusters is delayed for Mei (ticket raised to infra, ETA 2026-04-23). Action: Carlos to escalate if not resolved by EOD 2026-04-22.
  - Documentation: the "first-week tasks" doc for serving-runtime needs update - missing KV-cache debug walkthrough. Action: Aisha to draft and link to Confluence onboarding playbook.
  - Mentorship pairing: Ravi assigned to mentor Jordan (first 2 weeks); Janelle paired with Priya for production deploy run-through.
- Pairing wins: Janelle completed a successful mock deploy to staging and surfaced two small observability gaps (missing metric for prefix-cache hit rate). Action: file issue (JIRA-ENG-1456) to add metric.

Team health signals / pulse:
- Bandwidth: several infra folks report high context-switching due to customer pilot prep + oncall rotations. Consider temporary rebalancing or small overtime window for the pilot.
- Morale: overall good; new hires onboarding smoothly. A few devs flagged burnout risk if current cadence continues for 6+ weeks. Suggest monitor and optional skip week for non-critical meetings during pilot ramp.
- Cross-team friction: minor slowdown in resource provisioning between infra and platform teams. Carlos to host async sync and propose SLA for cluster provisioning (target 48-72 hrs).

Action items (owners and dates):
- Priya: run interviewer calibration session, Tue 2026-04-28.
- Maria (recruiter): schedule onsites for CAND-117 and CAND-120 by 2026-04-24.
- Priya: extend offer to CAND-123 by 2026-04-22 (high priority).
- Aisha: draft "KV cache debug" onboarding doc and add to Confluence by 2026-04-23.
- Carlos: escalate GPU cluster access for Mei by EOD 2026-04-22; host async infra provisioning sync by 2026-04-24.
- Jordan: confirm 2 backup interviewers for backend loop (Mateo, Liwei) by 2026-04-23.
- Team: reduce non-essential meetings week-of 2026-05-04 to allow pilot prep. Manager approval needed - Priya to confirm.

Notes / loose threads:
- Revisit interview rubric for ML infra portion post-calibration and add specific sample questions for quantization and kernel tradeoffs.
- Consider short "GPU toolchain 101" brown bag for SREs and backend engineers to raise baseline knowledge. Carlos to propose topics.
- Keep an eye on candidate pipeline metric: days-in-loop per role. Engineering leadership wants weekly snapshot for PMs. Aisha to add to next sync agenda.

Next sync: weekly debrief same time next week (Wed 2026-04-28). If urgent, ping #eng-hiring channel on Slack.

Raw/working notes below (bullet points, shorthand):
- CAND-117: liked his example of reducing tail latency via request shaping + KV cache warmers. Good docs.
- CAND-120: SRE - pager triage example with cognitive load mitigation. Good runbook practice.
- CAND-123: quantization pipelines, perf benches - owns tooling work. strong match.
- Onboarding: Mei blocked on GPU creds - infra ticket 9892; Ravi ramping ok; Janelle flagged missing metric for prefix-cache.
- Recruiter: need faster decisioning.

End of notes.
